source.file: Historical workbook (not required for replay; see input_stats.json)
source.authority: Latest user upload, not older GitHub workbook

explicit_user_clarifications: Fortify at SL5 = 15% from 3%*SL; use formula rather than stale K33=30%.
Frozen is Immobilized; it does not disable passive skills or AP recovery.
Each target holds only one Connection; first cast wins.
Transferred damage stops at first protector, never relayed.
6 passive points including skill unlock; 1000 total battles, 500 per starting order.
Do not overlap Frozen Axe: reject rows containing any living character currently Frozen. Prefer another legal Front row; otherwise another legal action.
current_file_rules: Base stats HP51750 MP19450 ATK5357.142857 DEF1857.142857 SDEF1086.206897 MHR120% APR70; no crit, penetration or evasion.
Frozen Axe SL5 initial SATK480 and DOT SATK480, AP150 MP3000 CD6 duration3. DOT ticks END of every global turn; different caster sources stack.
Deadly Strike SL5 SATK16800, AP300 MP6000 CD4, only below50%HP.
Connection SL5 auto-cast at own team-turn start, MP800 CD2 duration2. Share50% AFTER mitigation, Fortify15%, Resistance15%.
Initial cooldown initialized full; first default recovery at end of first own turn, thereafter every global turn end. Cast sets cooldown before effects; cast turn gets default end-turn recovery.
Effects applied at T expire at END of T+D-1. Frozen duration3 cast at T ticks DOT at END T,T+1,T+2.
Build4 second branch grants HA20%, Exposure-20% from Frozen Axe, 20% chance to heal0.5%HP When Being Attacked, and heal2.5%MaxHP each own team turn.
Attack/Hit/Offensive Cast are distinct; no normal-attack trigger from DOT or transferred damage.
battle_setup: Nine identical Bluetooth per side. Main at back-center position8. All HP/MP full, AP0 initially.
10 skill points: Frozen Axe5 plus specialization skill5. No reallocation.
Build1 final ATK6696.428571, APR108, secondary damage factor75%. Build4 DEF2557.142857, HA20%, APR70, secondary factor50%.
Initial slots2,2,4,4,5 thereafter; prioritize higher AP, random ties; eligible AP>=100 and not Frozen. AP may be negative after cast.
No swaps, Defend or slot transfers selected by AI.
Front means frontmost living in each column. Primary priority: exposed main, else lowest current HP, random equal-HP ties.

Cast normally: Deadly when ready/funded/below50%HP, else Frozen when ready/funded, else normal. Auto-casts respect MP and cooldown. Frozen Axe is only selected for a row with no living Frozen targets. If none is available, use normal attack (or eligible Deadly Strike).
event_and_effect_conventions: At team-turn start, in position order: each living build4 character regenerates then attempts Connection. Then recover acting-team AP and allocate action slots. Auto-casts do not consume slots.
End turn: DOT ticks in recipient team0/team1, position order, then source order; immediately stop on main death. Then recover cooldowns and expire effects.

Damage is mitigated by original target DEF/SDEF, then secondary final-damage penalty, then final damage split50/50. Protector does not mitigate again; shared portion cannot trigger another transfer or When Being Attacked.
Fortify/Resistance snapshot caster current DEF/SDEF at cast; bonuses added as flat increases. Exposure reduces Total Base SDEF20%, not DEF; flat Resistance bonus is added afterwards.
A dead protector cannot receive further damage transfers. Existing buff duration persists; no overkill spillback.

Connection targets exclude caster, choose2 lowest absolute current HP; equal HP ties by position. Existing link cannot be overwritten; do not retarget to another ally. Affordable valid casts spend MP even if links already occupied.
Same-caster DOT refreshes; different casters stack. No more than one concurrent stack per caster on a target. DOT persists after caster death.
Frozen and Exposure are nonstacking refresh effects applied after initial damage; expire end of final turn.
When Being Attacked: one probability check per normal Attack per directly struck surviving recipient, after all hits finish. No heal check for offensive casts, DOT or shared damage.
Heal capped at missing HP; HA20% gives regen1552.5 and triggered heal310.5. Effective-healing metrics exclude overheal.
No per-hit rounding. 600 global turn cap reported as unresolved.
limitations: Result is conditional on this skill-first AI and target priority, not optimal-play balance.
Several rules changed together from previous experiments; outcome change cannot be attributed to one nerf alone.
Latest workbook is read only; no design/GitHub updates made.
validation: Duration last-turn activity and end-turn expiration; initial/end-turn cooldown; three end-turn DOT ticks; two caster DOT source stacking; auto-cast MP/cooldown; Fortify15%; Exposure SDEF scope; no double mitigation and no relay; healing values.
Every turn checks HP conservation, HP/MP bounds; every action checks legal Front targeting. Exactly1000 battles including sample log.
Assert zero Frozen overlap applications in every final-batch battle; focused check selects another legal unfrozen row.
